evidence: C1 sits in the passive column immediately right of U1's pin row, within roughly 2-3 mm of the IC with no other component between it and the package.
Each channel reads bottom-to-top (screw terminal -> C/D/R filter row -> U1 -> I2C header J5 at top) with monotonic ratsnest lines and no doubling back across any group.

In every channel the terminal's left pin (AIN) connects up-right to the series R while the right pin (GND) connects up-left to C/D (e.g. J1 pin1 at x~105 to R1 at x~222 crosses GND pad at x~177 to C2 at x~138), producing an X in the ratsnest that forces crossover traces on all four channels.
There is no on-board regulation; +3V3 enters at header J5 and flows directly to the single load U1 with its local decoupling C1 at the IC, so the trivial input->load order is respected.
